prompt:
Game enemy lineup sheet: TEN different melee enemy sprites of one fire clan arranged in a strict grid of 5 columns by 2 rows on ONE image, every character in its own invisible cell of equal size, each cell one fifth of the image width and one half of the image height. The top row holds the five weakest creatures and the bottom row the five strongest, each row growing from the left to the right: the creatures get heavier, more armoured and more glowing with rank. Each is a chunky grim fantasy cartoon character, never cute, never a mascot. All TEN are in SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera, facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the image, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body, standing UPRIGHT in a calm ready stance with both feet on ONE horizontal ground line, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward. Every biped character has TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH; the Ember Hound and the Flame Drake stand on FOUR LEGS of exactly the same size; the Magma Slime has no limbs. Every character has a face built from the fewest bold shapes, TWO BOLD GLOWING eye shapes with no pupils, skin in two flat tones. Layout rules: each character is VERY SMALL inside its cell and centered horizontally in it, with the soles of the feet on a line at 70% of the cell height, a very wide empty background space on both sides of every character and an empty band above the head; the ten characters are far apart, clearly separated by empty background, and no weapon, hand or cloak ever reaches the neighbouring cell. Sizes: characters 1 to 8 are all the same medium size in bulk, even the small creatures, all with the same amount of detail; characters 9 and 10 are huge, about one and a half times that height. The weakest are on the left of the top row and the strongest on the right of the bottom row in rank, shown by armour, size of weapon and amount of glow.
TOP ROW, left to right:
1. SPARK IMP, no weapon: a skinny imp about 3 heads tall with a head crowned by a tall flame of hair, charcoal skin with a few glowing cracks, big pointed ears, two clenched fists, empty hands.
2. EMBER HOUND, on four legs: a lean muscular hound in side view with charcoal fur, a mane of flames along the neck, glowing cracks on the flanks, a long tail ending in a flame, ember-glowing teeth; all four paws on the ground line; no weapon.
3. CINDER GOBLIN: a lean goblin with big pointed ears, singed rags, a long nose, ONE burning wooden torch used as a club, held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image, with a flame on its head.
4. MAGMA SLIME, no limbs: a low wide dome-shaped blob of molten rock sitting on the ground line, a crust of black obsidian plates on its top, glowing cracks and two glowing eyes on its front, thick drips at the bottom; no weapon.
5. ASH CULTIST: a hooded cultist in an ash-grey robe edged in red, ONE short mace with a head shaped like a censer full of glowing coals held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image, a scarf of embers.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right:
6. SALAMANDER WARRIOR: a lizard-man with red scales, a head frill, a long thick tail held low behind him, light armour plates, ONE one-handed axe held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image.
7. OBSIDIAN GOLEM, brawny, no weapon: a stocky golem built of black obsidian plates with glowing orange cracks, a square head with a glowing visor slit, huge fists, empty hands.
8. BLAZE DUELIST, agile: an athletic fighter in a half mask with a flaming scarf, TWO curved blades each with a glowing edge, one in each hand, held low.
9. LAVA OGRE, huge: a gigantic ogre with cracked molten skin, a glowing furnace belly, a small head, ONE huge anvil-shaped hammer held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image.
10. FLAME DRAKE, huge, on four legs: a dragon on four legs with its wings folded flat against its back, a horned head, a long tail, glowing spine fins, claws; all four feet on the ground line; no weapon.
COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: the whole clan shares ONE dominant hue, a fiery red-orange (hue about 8 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #5A1A12, base #B8321E, light #E8603A, top highlight #F5A07A, for the scales, the robes, the flames and the armour. ONE warm family for the skin, the fur and the stone: charcoal #3A2E2E with shadow #231A1C and light #5E4A48, leather #6A4430 and #4A2E22. ONE accent family, glowing gold #F2B632 with shadow #C98A1A, ONLY on the glowing eyes, the cracks and the sparks. Rules: large areas are mid values; only the eyes and the cracks are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline of every character is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. The higher the rank, the more glow, plate and flame. Steel for blades #8A8C8E with shadow #5B5E62.
Everything stays inside the frame with a margin on every side, every weapon tip at least 20% below the top edge of its cell. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no grid lines, no cell borders, no numbers, no text, no scenery. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.
Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky cartoon enemy illustration, each character designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded volumes, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, hands and weapons enlarged and legs shrunk. Flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones with the large areas in MID values; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots on large surfaces. Medium detail only: bold simple shapes, no fine engraving, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
